research_goal: every 10 minutes reconstruct the current hydraulic state from sparse causal sensing, learn all-109 action effects on future system-wide cumulative TFV, optimize inside D3-HOLD TrainFit support, execute only when an optimizer-aware one-sided H360 residual upper bound remains beneficial, then re-observe

core_pipeline.step1: causal sparse sensing -> current full-network hydraulic reconstruction
core_pipeline.step2: causal current state + causal rainfall + complete H360 reference/candidate actions -> authoritative exact delta TFV
core_pipeline.admission_calibration: combine rainfall-disjoint D3 HOLD cached residuals with exact same-prefix H360 SWMM residuals of optimizer-selected Development plans
core_pipeline.step3: screen all 109 facilities, optimize q95-supported joint actions, execute iff predicted delta TFV + calibrated one-sided residual margin < 0 and the first 10-minute block changes; otherwise HOLD
core_pipeline.swmm: authoritative offline label/evaluation/calibration truth only; never called inside online candidate search

action_contract.engineering_bounds: physical min/max plus <=0.5 setting movement per 10-minute update
action_contract.support_bounds: per-facility TrainFit q95 action magnitude plus D3-HOLD joint-density q95, never above observed D3-HOLD joint maximum
action_contract.statistical_admission: 90% one-sided residual upper margin, conservatively taking the maximum supported by D3 HOLD cached residuals and exact optimizer-selected same-prefix H360 SWMM residuals

scientific_bottleneck.mechanism: continuous optimizer selection-induced optimism / false-beneficial actions
scientific_bottleneck.evidence: T5 exact same-prefix H360 replay had 3/6 false-beneficial despite zero prefix mismatch; T10 benefit nearly vanished and T20 exceeded no-control under threshold-free V5/V4

step3_current.active_support: q95 canonical; q90 conservative ablation; q99 diagnostic only
step3_current.admission: optimizer-aware upper bound < 0; weak/uncertain extrema HOLD

data_boundaries.D3: training plus rainfall-disjoint internal residual calibration/audit
data_boundaries.optimizer_replay: Development-only exact same-prefix H360 calibration; its event IDs cannot be counted as independent post-calibration evidence

legacy.Step3_V4: threshold-free ablation that exposed optimizer selection-induced optimism

promotion_rule: first restore event-balanced no-control non-inferiority and reduce exact same-prefix false-beneficial decisions on post-calibration Development events; only then reassess Internal/Auto-RBC competitiveness and untouched Validation
